name: concurrent-mutation
question: Have LTADS lifecycle files or ltads/execution/<arc>/ been externally mutated since this session's last known-good snapshot?
cost_provenance: measured 2026-07-20 on the ULDF framework repo under Git Bash (win32; slowest supported environment): 3 runs 711-862ms (git-log + per-file mtime delta over the tracked LTADS path set). Declared 1800ms is ~2x measured for git-history variance headroom, honestly below the 2000ms fast-lane ceiling (ORACLE-COST-01). The prior 3000ms conflated the fast-lane timeout floor with expected runtime; the runner's auto-demotion (ORACLE-COST-03) is the safety net for pathological repos.

schema.external_mutation: boolean (true when >=1 tracked LTADS path was externally mutated since the baseline)

mutations.since: string (ISO-8601 timestamp the mutation was observed: commit committer-date for git-log, file mtime for mtime)
mutations.by_session: string|null (attributed sessionId when derivable; null for uncommitted writes and human-authored commits -- never this session, that is why it is reported)

schema.baseline_age_seconds: integer|null (seconds since the baseline snapshot was captured; null when no baseline exists for this session -- graceful absence)
schema.briefing: string (empty when external_mutation=false; one-liner suitable for ORACLE BRIEFING when true -- the session-start hook prepends the [concurrent-mutation] tag)

fallback: Read .claude/session-state/this-session.json csi10Baseline (sessionId + mtimes map + headSha + sessionStart). For each tracked LTADS path (ltads/arc-state.json, ltads/arc-state.archive.json, ltads/sessions/session-history.md, ltads/sessions/blockers.md, and every file under ltads/execution/) compare the current file mtime against csi10Baseline.mtimes[path]; a current mtime later than the baseline that this session did not author is an uncommitted external write. Then git diff --name-only <baseline.headSha>..HEAD over the same paths catches committed external mutations. Either signal firing means another session mutated the arc state. No baseline / baseline.sessionId != your sessionId -> cannot deduce mutation, report external_mutation:false (failure-open).

provenance.note: CSI Phase 3 (artifact-time leg of the three-leg defense). Phase 1 = prompt-level visibility; Phase 2 = runtime gates (CSI-07/08/09); Phase 3 = this oracle, which detects external mutation independently of any in-session decision. Hybrid baseline per DEC-22 (git-log delta + per-file mtime delta). Uses the CSI-10 domain schema (external_mutation/mutations/baseline_age_seconds/summary) per SPECIFICATION CSI-10 acceptance, mirroring the CSI briefing-oracle convention (stale-ltads-state, dispatchable-sessions) of a domain schema plus a briefing field rather than the generic status/details envelope; the read-only run.{sh,ps1} never write -- the baseline is persisted by the sibling update-baseline.{sh,ps1}, wired into the session-start hook and /0-uldf-finalize.

config.comment: Tracked path set per CSI-10. Keep these aligned with run.sh / run.ps1 / update-baseline.{sh,ps1} (the scripts hardcode the same defaults for the <2s speed contract). Extend tracked_files/tracked_dirs to widen scope.
